name: Agentic NFT Launchpad
description: Public ERC-721 mint collections on BNB Smart Chain, with per-collection mint eligibility rules.

walletModel.agentWallet: Agents may use a compatible EVM wallet and authorized signing tooling.
walletModel.humanWallets: Any EVM wallet that can sign BNB Smart Chain transactions.

eligibility.description: Eligibility is collection-specific. Check the registry entry's agentIdRequired field and the deployed contract's on-chain rules. Agent ID is required only for collections that explicitly enforce it.

mint.rules: Read live contract state and per-wallet or per-Agent-ID limits before submitting. Only registry entries with status deployed are eligible. Free allocation may sell out while paid allocation remains.

safety: Verify contract address against the public registry and BscScan.
Read mintPrice, remainingSupply and applicable wallet or Agent ID limits before minting.
Never expose or request private keys, seed phrases or wallet recovery material.
Do not assume Agent ID is required unless the collection metadata and contract say so.
